versions.changelog:
- Added MIROMIND_EMAIL and MIROMIND_PASSWORD as required environment variables in the skill metadata.
- Updated metadata to include the primaryEnv field for improved configuration guidance.
- Now enforces environment variable checks before execution, improving configuration error handling.
- No code or user-facing feature changes; documentation and metadata only.

Initial release of MiroMind Deep Research Skill.

- Provides deep research capability via MiroThinker AI, triggered with `/miromind`.
- Requires Playwright MCP skill and browser automation; setup and credential configuration instructions included.
- Uses a direct URL submission method for research queries, enabling robust automated session handling.
- Automatically logs in if needed and generates/shareable chat URLs for real-time research progress.
- Polls and extracts finalized research results, saving reports as Markdown files for user access.
